mentioned.quote: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production. AI systems with the ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds

threshold.quote: AI systems with the ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds (e.g., undergraduate STEM degrees) create/obtain and deploy chemical and/or biological weapons with serious potential for catastrophic damages.
threshold.note: Second, higher threshold (novel CB weapons production) on p.7.

response.quote: We will maintain or improve on our ASL-3 protections, which include classifier guards at least as robust as our initial Constitutional Classifiers; access controls for trusted users with exemptions to classifier guards; red-teaming, bug bounties, and threat intelligence for continually assessing the threat of jailbreaks; and a number of noteworthy security controls.
response.note: Middle column 'our plan as a company'. Judgement: this is an ongoing commitment in the row for the threshold, not worded 'when the threshold is reached'. Footnote 3 says the column is an overview of commitments from elsewhere.

acc_decider.quote: The CEO and RSO will make the ultimate determination regarding the adequacy of the risk assessment and any downstream deployment or development plans.
acc_decider.note: Risk Reports cover high-stakes misalignment, automated R&D and CB weapons production (pp.11-12) and discuss whether thresholds are crossed (p.12). RSO also approves deployment decisions, p.16.

acc_external.quote: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy’s main procedural commitments.
acc_external.note: Framework-wide external review of adherence (rule C5). Also p.14: full external review of Risk Reports that cover highly capable models and are significantly redacted.

acc_unmet.quote: When we receive a report, we will promptly investigate, take appropriate and proportional corrective action if it is substantiated, and document the report and our findings.
acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide non-compliance procedure (C6b): investigate, document, notify the Board if material (p.16). Applies to every risk with a threshold.

mentioned.quote: Automated R&D in key domains. AI systems that can fully automate, or otherwise dramatically accelerate, the work of large, top-tier teams of human researchers

threshold.quote: We will consider this threshold to be met if we determine that either (1) our models would be able to fully substitute for our entire set of Research Scientists and Research Engineers, at competitive costs (i.e., within a factor of 5); or (2) there is “dramatic acceleration” of the pace of AI progress
threshold.note: Quantitative criteria and a defined doubling-of-progress scenario, pp.9-10.

response.quote: We will require a strong argument that catastrophic risk is contained, along the lines of our recommendations for industry-wide safety (see Section 1). We will delay AI development and deployment as needed to achieve this, until and unless we no longer believe we have a significant lead.
response.note: Appendix A, 'Anthropic in the lead'; a 'highly capable' model is defined as one crossing the automated AI R&D threshold (p.14). Contingent on competitor scenarios and 'as needed'. The p.8 company-plan bullets (moonshot security R&D, 'eyes on everything' logging, alignment assessments, red-teaming, Risk Reports) read as monitoring/evaluation or unnamed security levels, so were not used.
